Pose - Guarded Defensive Posture.description:
🕴️ Pose: Guarded Defensive Posture
Arms raised or positioned to protect — tense, wary, and ready to defend against incoming threat.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Guarded Defensive Posture.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, angle and slightly lower the shoulders, raise frame-visible hands into a loose guard, and keep the body compact with weight implied toward the rear without forcing hidden legs into view. Female: shoulders drop and close in. Male: shoulders drop but stay squared. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own guard.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
